role: Sr. Software Engineer, Data Analytics Engineering
responsibilities: Develop and document practical instrumentation and experimentation standards, then partner with product engineering teams to apply them to priority product development work.
Build and improve scalable analysis pipelines and tooling that produce reliable insights at scale and strengthen understanding of key data structures and metrics.
Create tools and processes that enable Data Scientists and Engineers to independently access trusted datasets, insights and metric definitions.
Identify data quality and discoverability gaps, advocate for targeted improvements and contribute to reliable, well-governed data practices.
Maintain clear documentation for tools, datasets, metrics and operating practices to make team data assets easier to use.
Partner with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Data Engineering and Business Intelligence teams to communicate actionable insights and inform product improvements.
Use AI to accelerate analysis, prototyping and iteration, while applying judgment and verification to ensure correctness, quality and responsible use.

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Identify data quality and discoverability gaps, advocate for targeted improvements and contribute to reliable, well-governed data practices.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Quality, reliability, trusted datasets, governance and verification outnumber the speed phrases ("velocity", "fast-paced", "accelerate") by more than two to one. The same posting is also listed in Seattle.
evidence.domain_risk: Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Consumer platform analytics with no regulatory or financial-reporting language, so it is moderate.
evidence.collaboration_width: Product; Engineering; Data Science; Data Engineering; Business Intelligence
evidence.data_team_maturity: Partner with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Data Engineering and Business Intelligence teams
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: Separate data science, data engineering and BI teams at Pinterest's scale describe an established, specialised function.
evidence.jd_authorship: Develop and document practical instrumentation and experimentation standards, then partner with product engineering teams to apply them to priority product development work.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: The instrumentation bullet is specific, but most bullets are generic ("Maintain clear documentation"), so it is mixed.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Create tools and processes that enable Data Scientists and Engineers to independently access trusted datasets, insights and metric definitions.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The main audience is data scientists and engineers using self-service datasets and tooling.
evidence.autonomy_level: Develop and document practical instrumentation and experimentation standards
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role sets instrumentation standards but mostly contributes, advocates and partners, so it is mixed.
evidence.ai_role: Use AI to accelerate analysis, prototyping and iteration, while applying judgment and verification to ensure correctness
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The candidate uses AI to speed up their own work, so it is ai_user.
evidence.testing_framing: Identify data quality and discoverability gaps, advocate for targeted improvements
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Finding and fixing data-quality gaps is a responsibility, and verifying AI-assisted work through testing is required.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Reliability is named but secondary to enabling self-service, so it is moderate.
